]

    return response.json()

    if isinstance(user_data, dict) and isinstance(community_data, dict):
        for key, value in user_data.items():
            peer_value = community_data.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, (int, float)) and isinstance(peer_value, (int, float)):

                    "user_usage": value,
                    "community_average": peer_value,
